description: This PHP file defines the class ArrayCsrfTokenStorage, which implements the TokenStorageInterface for managing CSRF tokens using an in-memory array. It is used in tests to mock CSRF token storage behavior.

classes.name: ArrayCsrfTokenStorage
classes.description: A mock implementation of TokenStorageInterface that stores CSRF tokens in a PHP array for testing purposes.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the token associated with the given token ID, throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Sets a CSRF token for the given token ID.

methods.name: removeToken
methods.description: Removes the token associated with the given token ID and returns it, or null if not found.

methods.name: hasToken
methods.description: Checks if a token exists for the given token ID.
